name: Band Triceps Pushdown
steps: Loop a resistance band over a high anchor, stand tall facing it, and grip both sides of the band at chest height.
Tuck your elbows snugly against your sides with your shoulder blades settled back and down.
Press the band smoothly straight downward by extending both elbows until your arms lock straight beside your thighs.
Pause briefly to squeeze your triceps, then let your forearms rise slowly back to chest height under control.
tips: Keep your elbows pinned beside your ribs throughout the entire range instead of letting them drift forward.
Stand upright with a braced core rather than leaning forward to press the band down.
